tools.name: lob_verify_us_address
tools.description: Validate & standardize a US address, returning deliverability, corrected components, and a confidence score. Pass either a single freeform `address` string OR structured `primary_line`/`city`/`state`/`zip_code`. Non-mutating (no mail sent). Lob API: POST /v1/us_verifications.

tools.name: lob_verify_intl_address
tools.description: Validate & standardize a non-US address. `country` (2-letter ISO code) is required. Non-mutating (no mail sent). Lob API: POST /v1/intl_verifications.

tools.name: lob_us_zip_lookup
tools.description: Return the cities and state associated with a US ZIP code. Non-mutating. Lob API: POST /v1/us_zip_lookups.

tools.name: lob_us_autocomplete
tools.description: Suggest complete US addresses from a partial primary line — useful for address entry. Non-mutating. Lob API: POST /v1/us_autocompletions.

tools.name: lob_list_postcards
tools.description: List sent/scheduled postcards, newest first. Lob API: GET /v1/postcards.

tools.name: lob_get_postcard
tools.description: Retrieve a single postcard by id, including status, PDF url, and expected delivery. Lob API: GET /v1/postcards/{id}.

tools.name: lob_list_letters
tools.description: List sent/scheduled letters, newest first. Lob API: GET /v1/letters.

tools.name: lob_get_letter
tools.description: Retrieve a single letter by id, including status, PDF url, and tracking. Lob API: GET /v1/letters/{id}.

tools.name: lob_list_checks
tools.description: List sent/scheduled checks, newest first. Lob API: GET /v1/checks.

tools.name: lob_get_check
tools.description: Retrieve a single check by id, including amount, status, and check number. Lob API: GET /v1/checks/{id}.

tools.name: lob_list_self_mailers
tools.description: List sent/scheduled self-mailers, newest first. Lob API: GET /v1/self_mailers.

tools.name: lob_list_addresses
tools.description: List saved address records, newest first. Lob API: GET /v1/addresses.

tools.name: lob_get_address
tools.description: Retrieve a single saved address record by id. Lob API: GET /v1/addresses/{id}.

tools.name: lob_list_templates
tools.description: List saved HTML templates usable as postcard/letter artwork. Lob API: GET /v1/templates.

tools.name: lob_create_address
tools.description: Create a reusable saved address record (does NOT send any mail). Returns an address id (adr_…) usable as `to`/`from` in mail tools. Lob API: POST /v1/addresses.

tools.name: lob_cancel_postcard
tools.description: Cancel a postcard before its send_date so it is never mailed (and not billed). Fails if the send window has passed. Lob API: DELETE /v1/postcards/{id}.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "lob_create_letter" is 636 chars, far longer than this server's median (105). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lob_get_postcard, lob_get_letter, lob_list_templates · Private data: lob_list_addresses, lob_get_address, lob_create_address, lob_create_letter · Public sink: lob_verify_us_address, lob_verify_intl_address, lob_us_zip_lookup, lob_us_autocomplete, lob_create_address, lob_create_postcard, lob_create_letter, lob_cancel_postcard · Destructive: lob_cancel_postcard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lob_get_postcard, lob_get_letter, lob_list_templates · Private data: lob_list_addresses, lob_get_address, lob_create_address, lob_create_letter · Public sink: lob_verify_us_address, lob_verify_intl_address, lob_us_zip_lookup, lob_us_autocomplete, lob_create_address, lob_create_postcard, lob_create_letter, lob_cancel_postcard · Destructive: lob_cancel_postcard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
